The store is Pine Crossing. I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

- **Where it comes from:** Pree herself posted in #central-team on 9 June 2026 that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.
- **Follow-up:** Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem with the store login.
- **What I couldn't find:** there's no site code or address for Pine Crossing in #central-team or the shared files. I also found no later update saying the problem was fixed, so I suggested she check with Hollis before updating the sheet.
